correctness.rationale: The rank count separates characteristic odd/even via 2Xu=2Yv=0. In odd characteristic the 3x3 lower triangular matrix yields the stated rank counts. The coordinate ring with a0²=b0²=0 and Δ invertible proves reduced dimension 6 vs tangent dimension 8. Boundary q=2 fits and q=3 agrees with symbolic formulas. Script output was not rerun; all-field correctness rests on the symbolic proof, not finite logs.
